corpus: mixed human/model final text from earlier sessions
finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base advantage remains unresolved under both interval methods; pooled and uniform useful advantage is excluded under both. Useful donor advantage is excluded under writer resampling but unresolved under crossed resampling. All primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods, while pooled useful advantage is excluded under writer resampling but unresolved under crossed resampling; all residual model-rival intervals include zero. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods, with worse performance only under writer resampling. Raw base useful advantage is excluded under both methods, with worse performance only under writer resampling. Raw pooled useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods and donor only under crossed resampling, with pooled and donor intervals including zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Full final documents include accepted model insertions and do not isolate human-only learning. Additional passes repeat existing text; they do not add personal information. Sparse histories, rank transferred from human-text calibration, shared human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the recipe. No independent human confirmation, epoch ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
